stemMd: What constant c makes x squared+10x+c the square of a linear polynomial with leading coefficient 1?
explanationMd: A square (x+a) squared has middle coefficient 2a. Here a=5, so c=a squared=25. The expression becomes (x+5) squared.

distractorRationale.a: This is the binomial's constant before squaring.
distractorRationale.b: This is the middle coefficient, not the needed constant.
distractorRationale.e: This squares the full middle coefficient.
distractorRationale.c: This doubles rather than squares half the coefficient.
